title: Kahan gaye mere baba
body:
Mere baba...
Mere ammu... 2
kaha gaye mere baba
kaha gaye ammu... 2
sakina shaam ke zindaan me kar rahi thi pukar
kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
1.  Ajeeb shaam hai jo
bichda gawahi hai
Na koi waahi o waaris
Raha na bhai hai...
Phuphi ki sar se abhi
Zalimon ne cheeni rida...
kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
2.  Tamache khati hoon kaanon se khoon jari hai...
Yeh kisne Ashkon se kismat likhi hamari hai...
phuphi ke pallu rasham me bandhe hai mera gala...
kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
3.  Na Tishnagi ki Shikayat
Na Begali ka gila
Gila karu bhi tog kisse
Koi bhi ab na raha...
Hume toh lut liya
tune dashte Qarbobala...
kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
4.  Main katlegaah me jati hoon bayn karti hui...
Fiza me khoon ki bu
har taraf hai faeli hui...
koi batata nahi
shahe Qarbala ka pata..
kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
5.  Yeh kaisi aag lagai
hai aaj paani me...
sawal chhoda Asghar
ki bezubani ne...
Jawab dega bhala kaun
Al Qama ke siwa...
kaha gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
6.  Suna hai Qaed me kunbaan
hamara jaega
kadam kadam pe ye manzar
hume rulaega
Har ek Yateem sare-raah jab ye dega saza...
Kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
7.  Lahu bahaa hua ye
Paerohan dikhau kise
Tadap chhod gaye jo
the chahnewale
Yeh mujse puch raha
jala hua kurta...
Kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
8.  Zameen e Qarb pe suraj
ke paau jalte hai
Sitam hai aale Mohammad
usi pe chalte hai
Dikhaai deta nahi hai
dur tak koi saaya...
Kaha gaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
9.  Dayarisaah me
ya haal sach kaha tumne
Bahar jake ye
awaz khud suni humne
sunai deti hai Abbas
ab ye ek hi sadaa...
mere baba...
mere ammu...
